summary: Successfully tested the Jastip Bintang Snack mobile application frontend. Verified Add/Edit Item modal with Nama Penitip, Nama Item, Harga Pokok, Harga Jual, Titip, and Sisa fields. Confirmed column name changes ('Terjual' -> 'Sisa', 'Sisa (Setor)' -> 'Setor') and accurate calculation of Setor formula: (Titip - Sisa) * Harga Pokok. Tested local storage persistence via AsyncStorage and Rekap Setoran summary tab by consignor.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean code implementation using React Native, Expo Router, and AsyncStorage.
Form inputs and calculation preview fully operational with robust validations.
seed_data_creation: Initial consignment items seeded in mock.ts and persisted via AsyncStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All consignment item management, table columns, Setor formula calculation, and consignor rekap tab features are fully tested and working correctly.
